fields.columns: | columns event.time, event.type, site.name, agent.uuid, src.process.storyline.id, src.process.user, src.process.uid, src.process.cmdline, src.ip.address, src.port.number, dst.ip.address, dst.port.number, src.process.parent.cmdline, tgt.process.cmdline
fields.description: Detects execution of attacker-controlled WsmPty.xsl or WsmTxt.xsl via winrm.vbs and copied cscript.exe (can be renamed)
fields.name: AWL Bypass with Winrm.vbs and Malicious WsmPty.xsl/WsmTxt.xsl
fields.query: event.type="Process Creation" and (endpoint.os="windows" and (tgt.process.cmdline contains "winrm" and ((tgt.process.cmdline contains "format:pretty" or tgt.process.cmdline contains "format:\"pretty\"" or tgt.process.cmdline contains "format:\"text\"" or tgt.process.cmdline contains "format:text") and (not (tgt.process.image.path contains "C:\\Windows\\System32\\" or tgt.process.image.path contains "C:\\Windows\\SysWOW64\\")))))
